title: fisk-ai session store v1 common definitions

protocol.description: Record schema id, e.g. io.choria.fisk-ai.v1.session.meta. Self-describes the record independent of where it is stored.

seq.description: Monotonic record id within a run, the ordering authority. Starts at 1 on the meta record.

time.description: When the record was appended, in UTC. Absent on a record written before the field existed, which a reader dates from nothing rather than from the run's creation time.

optional.description: Set when a reader that does not recognize the protocol may skip the record. Only a record whose absence is fail-safe carries it: skipping one leaves the reader more conservative rather than differently behaved.

conversation_summary.description: What the conversation had cost when a turn ended, copied onto that turn's terminal record so a listing reads it without folding the journal. Folding gives the same numbers. Additive and optional; absent on a terminal record written before it existed, which a listing reports as absent rather than as zeros.

turns.description: How many turns the conversation has taken, this one included. The prompt on the meta record is the first and each user record after it is another.

context_tokens.description: The input the last model call carried, both prompt-cache tiers included, which is what the next turn sends again before adding its prompt.

counters.description: What the conversation spent, keyed as runstate.Counters serializes: llm_calls, tool_calls, remote_tool_calls, mcp_tool_calls, tool_calls_by_kind, in_tokens, out_tokens, cache_read_tokens, cache_create_tokens and thinking_tokens. A zero counter is omitted.

fingerprint.description: Configuration the run was started with; validated on resume. The system prompt is stored as a hash, never verbatim.

provider.description: Neutral provider id the run was started with. A resume against a different provider is refused unconditionally (--force does not apply).

reasoning_effort.description: The effort level the run was started with, absent when the provider takes none. Additive and optional; a fingerprint written before it existed compares equal to one that carries no effort.
